title: Effect of Omega-3 Supplementation on Serum Level and Gene Expression of IGF-1and IGFBP-3 in Men With CVD.

sections.abstract: The aim of this study is the comparison between the effects of supplementation with omega 3 or placebo for 8 weeks in serum level of IGF-1 and IGFBP-3 and gene expression of IGF-1 in patients with cardiovascular disease.
